title: [SEC6] Good: ResultReference chaining for Chat/query + Chat/get
description:
In app.js fetchChats() (lines 216-235), the code uses JMAP ResultReference (RFC 8620 §9) to chain Chat/query and Chat/get in a single request:

Query returns IDs, then immediately Get uses those IDs without a round-trip:
  '#ids': { resultOf: 'q0', name: 'Chat/query', path: '/ids' }

This:
- Eliminates a network round-trip
- Keeps ID list and chat objects in sync (no time gap)
- Is the correct JMAP pattern for this use case

Same pattern used in fetchMessages() (lines 313-335).

Alternative (fetch IDs, then make a second request) is less efficient and risks state skew if the chat list changes between requests.
